name: ohmo
description: A local-first desktop app that scouts job postings, tailors an ATS-safe resume and cover letter per posting, tracks applications, and preps interviews - driven by AI agents running on your own machine.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.test: node scripts/email-selftest.ts && node scripts/portable-selftest.ts && node scripts/provider-selftest.ts && node scripts/preflight-selftest.ts
